parameters.name: num_products
parameters.description: Total number of products in the weekly production planning problem

parameters.name: num_processes
parameters.description: Total number of production processes in the weekly production planning problem

parameters.name: processing_time
parameters.description: Processing-time matrix; hours required from process r to produce one unit of product p

parameters.name: capacity
parameters.description: Weekly capacity in hours available for each process r

parameters.name: hourly_cost
parameters.description: Hourly operating cost for each process r

parameters.name: selling_price
parameters.description: Unit selling price for each product p

parameters.name: minimum_production
parameters.description: Minimum weekly production requirement for each product p

parameters.name: idle_time_weight
parameters.description: Weight used to prefer lower idle time on each process r, typically proportional to hourly cost

variables.name: production_quantity
variables.description: Weekly production quantity of each product p

variables.name: idle_time
variables.description: Unused capacity on each process r during the week

constraints.name: capacity_limit
constraints.description: Process usage must stay within weekly capacity and any unused capacity is recorded as idle time for each process

constraints.name: minimum_production_requirement
constraints.description: Each product must meet its specified minimum weekly production requirement

constraints.name: minimum_profit_requirement
constraints.description: Achieved weekly profit must meet the required minimum profit target

constraints.name: nonnegative_production_quantity
constraints.description: Production quantities must be nonnegative for all products

constraints.name: nonnegative_idle_time
constraints.description: Idle time must be nonnegative for all processes

constraints.name: profit_definition
constraints.description: Total profit is defined from sales revenue minus operating costs associated with used process hours

constraints.name: weighted_idle_time_preference
constraints.description: Among feasible plans, lower weighted idle time is preferred using weights proportional to hourly operating costs

objectives.name: profit_maximization
objectives.description: maximize weekly profit subject to capacity, production, and minimum-profit requirements

objectives.name: idle_time_minimization
objectives.description: minimize weighted idle time across processes among feasible plans, using weights proportional to hourly operating costs

final_objective.description: Use preemption optimization to first maximize weekly profit, then among all profit-optimal feasible plans minimize weighted idle time across processes.
